leafpic

components · 0.2.0 · v4 C3 · aj-c-leafpic

A Reflections leaf's picture, drawn in ink on paper: the week's moods as seven dots, what each day kept (a pen and a microphone), the week's recordings as bars, or this week's days beside the weeks before as columns. The picture is said aloud as one sentence (role img); a mood colour is only support, the word is in the title and the caption.

Week

The week leaf: the day letters over seven dots, a kept day in its mood.

Sleep days

What came up: the days it came up on, lit in their mood; the rest empty rings.

Week so far

A new account, opened on Thursday: before joining dashed, today ringed, still ahead dotted.

Kept

What you kept: a pen and a microphone under each day, filled where kept.

Recordings

Your recordings: a bar each, drawn to the longest, which is in full ink.

Weeks

Over the weeks: the three weeks before, then this one, labelled by date.

Long

Stress test only: a long caption wraps under the picture.

Non-Latin

Stress test only: Russian and Japanese labels, not product copy.
